description: Golden M10 test-batch report: the S5.2 'report JSON parseable + 10/10 files covered + main re-runs 2/10 files and the verdicts agree' shape. The M10 scorer (bench.score.m10) scores a subagent's tool-loop report against THIS shape: it must (a) parse as JSON, (b) cover all 10 files with a per-file pass/fail verdict, and (c) agree with main's 2/10 spot re-run (the S5.9 #5 'verdicts agree'). The 10 files are files_000.py..files_009.py; 8 pass, 2 fail (files_003.py and files_007.py, the seeded failures in the M10 golden batch).
